intro: Nicosia rewards visitors who wander its walled Old City and cross the Green Line between two worlds. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: No metro or tram; the Old City is best on foot.
Buses are cheap but timetables are unreliable and few are air conditioned.
Taxis are diesel Mercedes with 'T' plates; check the meter is on.
Ride apps like Bolt and Uber operate in the south; coverage varies.
Car hire is affordable and useful for day trips beyond the city.
Bike sharing (Bike in Action) needs a smart card; ferries leave from Limassol and Larnaca.

buyuk_han.name: Buyuk Han
buyuk_han.price_text: Free to enter · cafés and shops charge separately
buyuk_han.hours: Courtyard roughly 08:00–22:00; shops vary, check on the day
buyuk_han.tip: Climb to the upper gallery for the courtyard view, then sit at a café below.

selimiye.name: Selimiye Mosque
selimiye.hours: Open outside prayer times; modest dress needed, check on the day
selimiye.tip: It was a Gothic cathedral before it became a mosque, so look for both styles side by side.

bellapais.name: Bellapais Abbey
bellapais.price_text: Small entry fee, roughly a few euro; check on the day
bellapais.hours: Daily, roughly 08:00–17:00 in winter, later in summer
bellapais.tip: The refectory windows frame the coast — go early before tour buses arrive.

kyrenia_castle.name: Kyrenia Castle
kyrenia_castle.price_text: Modest entry fee, a few euro; check on the day
kyrenia_castle.tip: The Shipwreck Museum inside is the highlight — allow extra time for it.

souvla.name: Souvla (grilled meat)
souvla.hours: Most tavernas open lunch and dinner; many close one day a week
souvla.tip: Order it at a local taverna rather than a tourist strip for better value.

ledra_walk.name: Ledra Street crossing and walk
ledra_walk.price_text: Free · bring your passport for the crossing
ledra_walk.hours: Crossing open daily, roughly 08:00–20:00; check on the day
ledra_walk.tip: Walk the full pedestrian street on both sides — the contrast is the point.

laiki_walk.name: Laiki Geitonia old-quarter walk
laiki_walk.tip: Wander the narrow lanes off the main street for cafés and craft shops.

bandabulya.name: Bandabulya covered market
bandabulya.price_text: Free to browse; produce prices vary
bandabulya.hours: Roughly 07:00–18:00, closed Sunday; check on the day
bandabulya.tip: Come in the morning for the freshest produce and local cheese.

shacolas_view.name: Shacolas Tower viewpoint
shacolas_view.price_text: Small fee, a few euro; check on the day
shacolas_view.tip: Best spot to see the Green Line and both halves of the city at once.

cyprus_museum.name: Cyprus Museum
cyprus_museum.price_text: Modest entry fee, a few euro; check on the day
cyprus_museum.tip: The terracotta figures and gold jewellery are worth the visit alone.

buyuk_han_cafe.name: Buyuk Han courtyard cafés
buyuk_han_cafe.tip: Sit in the shaded courtyard for Turkish coffee and people-watching.

arasta.name: Arasta Street market walk
arasta.tip: Good for local sweets and crafts; bargain politely.

green_line.name: Green Line viewpoint walk
green_line.hours: Always open; stay on marked streets
green_line.tip: Do not photograph near checkpoints or soldiers; keep to the main streets.

hamam.name: Historic hamam visit
hamam.price_text: ≈ €15–30 depending on treatment; check on the day
hamam.tip: Book a slot and bring a towel; mixed hours may apply.

city_walls.name: Venetian city walls walk
city_walls.tip: Walk a stretch of the star-shaped walls for a different view of the old city.

meze_dinner.name: Meze dinner at a local taverna
meze_dinner.hours: Dinner from roughly 19:00; book on weekends
meze_dinner.tip: Meze comes in many small plates — pace yourself and share.

halloumi_breakfast.name: Halloumi breakfast
halloumi_breakfast.tip: Try grilled halloumi with bread, olives and local honey.

ledra_palace.name: Ledra Palace crossing area
ledra_palace.hours: Daylight; do not linger at barriers
ledra_palace.tip: View it from a distance; photography rules are strict.

buffavento.name: Buffavento Castle ruins
buffavento.price_text: Free; check access on the day
buffavento.tip: Wear sturdy shoes; the climb is steep but the views are wide.

selimiye_square.name: Selimiye Square and Ataturk statue
selimiye_square.tip: A good meeting point before exploring the old bazaar lanes.

sweets_shop.name: Local sweets and coffee stop
sweets_shop.tip: Try Turkish delight and a strong coffee before heading on.

walking_tour.name: Old city guided walking tour
walking_tour.hours: Usually morning and late afternoon departures; book ahead
walking_tour.tip: Ask the guide to cover both sides of the city for context.

park_bench.name: Municipal garden rest stop
park_bench.tip: A shady break between sights; bring water in summer.

plans.for: One packed day on foot: the old city walls, the Green Line and Ottoman landmarks, with a meze dinner to finish.

stays.why: Restored pedestrian lanes inside the walls; walk to Ledra Street and the main sights.
Cheapest base for history and food; quiet at night, a short walk to the sights.
Central and lively, with cafés and shops; easy crossing point to the north.
Quieter and cheaper; good for the bazaar and Büyük Han. Bring your passport for the crossing.

food: Try halloumi, sheftalia sausages and a meze spread; portions are large, so share.
Old town cafés serve strong Cypriot coffee; ask for it 'sketo' (no sugar) or 'metrio' (medium).
The north side has cheaper kebabs and sweets around the bazaar; check prices first.
Lunch is the main meal; many places close mid-afternoon, so eat early.
A sit-down meze for two costs roughly EUR 30–50; a cheap souvlaki lunch about EUR 6–10.
more_time: Hire a car for a day trip to the Troodos mountains or the Kyrenia range; check the border rules first.
Add a half-day to the Archaeological Museum and the Byzantine Museum for deeper history.
Swap an afternoon for a walk along the Green Line and the buffer-zone viewpoints.
